args.title: checkout-api failing health checks; rollback to v2.3.0 blocked by rollback service outage
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Attempted to roll back to the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.0), but the rollback tool is returning 503 Service Unavailable after multiple retries. Rollback is currently blocked; manual intervention required.

trace.final:
I was unable to complete the rollback because the rollback tool is persistently returning `503 Service Unavailable` (retried multiple times). Here's what I did and found:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` is currently on `v2.3.1`, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
- Deployment history shows the most recent healthy production release is `v2.3.0` (the `v2.3.1-rc` staging entry is unhealthy and not a production release).

**Action taken**
- Attempted to roll back `checkout-api` to `v2.3.0` in all regions — the rollback tool returned `503 Service Unavailable` on every attempt (7 retries), so the rollback could not be executed.

**Incident opened**
- Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and that the rollback is blocked by the rollback service outage.

The rollback still needs to be completed once the rollback service is available again.
